title: DFT peak frequency estimate
prompt: Implement `peak_frequency_hz(y, fs)` using a DFT magnitude peak (skip DC). Return Hz. Stdlib cmath/math.
public_tests_hint: - recovers a clean tone within 1 bin
test_source:
import cmath, math
import solution

def _tone(fs,f,n=256):
    return [math.sin(2*math.pi*f*i/fs) for i in range(n)]

def run():
    fs=128.0
    y=_tone(fs, 16.0)
    hat=solution.peak_frequency_hz(y, fs)
    assert abs(hat-16.0) <= fs/len(y) + 1e-9
